page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core metrics, falls within the average tier. However, memory read bandwidth and multi-threaded decompression tasks show weaker relative performance, placing in the bottom 25%. Cryptographic operations and single-threaded compression perform at average levels, supported by hardware-accelerated instruction sets like AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c8a.xlarge offers a dedicated compute profile at a lower resource density, making it a viable option for workloads requiring consistent CPU allocation without the overhead of excess memory. It is suited for single-threaded processing, text processing, lightweight web serving, and basic computational tasks that do not demand high memory bandwidth or local disk I/O.
